title: Third GTA6 Gameplay Video Leaks Online as Rockstar Scrambles to Remove Footage
description: A third seemingly real GTA6 gameplay video has leaked online, bearing the CyberLeek watermark as Rockstar works to remove it.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Third Seemingly Real GTA6 Video Leaks Online

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, another video of what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has surfaced online. This marks yet another incident in a series of unexpected leaks surrounding Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title.

## Watermarked by Alleged Group

As noted in the reports, the newly leaked footage bears the watermark of a group allegedly connected with earlier leaks, known as CyberLeek. The presence of this specific identifier suggests a continuation of the previous material distribution pattern.

## Rockstar's Response and Content Removal

In the wake of these unauthorized video appearances, Rockstar Games has been actively working behind the scenes. The studio has reportedly been scrambling to remove the footage from the internet across various platforms. As of now, no official statement regarding the legitimacy of the video has been released by the developers.

## Editor's Take

Unplanned leaks of this magnitude are undoubtedly challenging for any development studio. While the gaming community remains eager for any glimpse of GTA6, it is important to view these unverified leaks with caution and respect the developers' efforts to control their official rollout.
